research_role: Independent synthetic research contributor on existing PR #1327; Amalgam PR #1278 sole canonical learner/integration owner
objective: Falsify KNOW19 source-computable utility labels with a persistent within-world hidden mechanism whose stochastic action consequences cannot be calculated from public x/action without actually observing outcomes.

hypotheses.positive_engineering: An outcome-count learner trained only on one-world witnessed actions reduces Brier loss >=0.02 relative to p=0.5 and retains earlier world A readouts after learning changed world B
hypotheses.negative_science: Fully trained identical-information Bayesian and conventional controls may tie or beat the learner; without independent original-world first use and strongest-control gain the science verdict is DEV_NO_GO
hypotheses.null: No significant calibrated prediction improvement vs source-only p=0.5 or failures in cold functional retention

world.public_features: two binary observations x0,x1; proposed binary action a
world.outcome_noise: binary output equals hidden deterministic mechanism bit with probability 7/8, flipped with probability 1/8; stochastic draws witnessed separately, never included as model inputs
world.mechanism_visibility: hidden mechanism index and stochastic coin are simulator-only; not supplied to fitted learners
world.sequentiality: one fixed hidden mechanism per persistent world, all training and evaluation events within that world; no hidden-role resampling per query
world.public_action_schedule: fully balanced deterministic sequence of the eight x0/x1/a combinations; candidate and all controls observe same action stream in the same chronological order
world.source_only: x0,x1,a,world public opaque ID; no role, outcomes or counterfactual utilities encoded in source
world.world_knowledge: known function family is available only to independently fitted exact Bayesian generative comparator; candidate count learner and conventional comparator have no supplied function class

budgets.action_budget_per_active_arm: same fixed evidence stream; no adaptive action choice in this gate

candidate.representation: bounded tokenless numeric append-only world-keyed 8-context Bernoulli sufficient statistics n0/n1
candidate.update: after one action outcome increment exactly one count for that world, x0,x1,a; no hidden-operator labels
candidate.cold_restore: canonical sorted JSON counts bytes and SHA256, reject altered or duplicate event IDs; after B read original 8 A forecasts and cold restore all unchanged
candidate.unseen_context: forecast p=0.5, not an observed consequence

controls: p=0.5 source-only uninformed baseline (no witnessed outcome)
same-data fully fitted exact categorical symbolic Beta(1,1) table (expected candidate tie)
same-data fully fitted conventional depth-3 binary partition tree with Beta leaf smoothing
same-data fully trained exact Bayesian distribution over all four possible hidden operators with 1/8 known flip probability and uniform mechanism prior (strong, broader inductive class)
oracle knows hidden operator and noise rate; not a fair learned baseline, report ceiling

evaluation.primary: Mean Brier score on 512 separately witnessed prospective evaluation outcomes after fit, computed over 8 held worlds; no evaluation outcomes enter training
secondary: mean calibration error by predicted probability bins
per-operator Brier including previously untrained mechanisms 2/3
whole synthetic execution wall time, model bytes, train/eval action counts, source-only negative
original native GF2 remains unmodified; no claim of native accumulator itself probabilistically upgraded
evaluation.engineering_threshold: Candidate held Brier <=0.23 (vs exact p0.5 Brier 0.25), all A forecasts unchanged after B and independent cold restore, deterministic repeated fixture result; report FAIL if unmet
evaluation.science_threshold: No synthetic fixture result can establish SCIENTIFIC_PASS. Must beat strongest fully trained equal-information control by a separately preregistered >=0.01 Brier difference on owner-admitted genuinely unfamiliar original-world first-use, plus cold changed-rule retention and matched whole-process cost; no qualification without owner
evaluation.no_post_hoc: Never change seeds, thresholds, mechanism family, evaluation selection, noise or scoring after first scored run

negative_controls: source-only p=0.5 independent of hidden world
outcomes with same public x/a may contradict across stochastic draws and different latent worlds; original deterministic GF2 would reject contradictions
shuffled or forged outcome events rejected by typed unique event-ID/source checks
no within-world training from evaluation outcomes
retaining A across disjoint world keys not proof of task-interference resistance
new world identities alone not unfamiliar mechanism transfer; novel operators 2/3 are declared but Bayesian comparator is told full family
governance: Existing PR research source/tests only; no new PR/controller/scheduler, no protected source first use, no accepted main/owner checkpoint changes, no paid API, no model merge/promotion, no claiming deployed learning
